entities.title: The hive, the ship and its shot
entities.summary: The hive's shape and sway, the start of a game, the ship's limits and its one shot.
criteria: 37 aliens in five rows, all on screen at either end of the sway
The title screen waits; 1 starts a one-player game and 2 a two-player game
Only one shot is in the air at a time
The ship stops at the screen's edges
Pause stops the game and the next press resumes it

entities.title: Scoring, waves and the extra ship
entities.summary: Points at home and diving, the queen's bonus, rams, the next wave and the one extra ship.
criteria: An alien scores its hive value at home and more diving
A diving queen is worth 200, 400 or 800 by how many of her escorts fell first
A diving alien that rams the ship destroys both
Clearing the hive brings the next wave and a full hive
An extra ship comes once, at 7,000

entities.title: Game over and turns
entities.summary: One player's game ends with their last ship; two players take turns and the one still in plays on.
criteria: One player: losing every ship ends the game, keeps the high score and returns to the title
Two players take turns, each with their own hive, score and ships
When one is out, the other plays on alone until they are out too
A long game of random play never breaks: positions stay finite, lives and scores never go negative

entities.title: Recording and replay
entities.summary: A recorded game replays to the same scores, only whole games replay, and the trigonometry is exact enough.
criteria: dsin and dcos agree with Math.sin and Math.cos to 1e-6
Every six-bit input packs and unpacks to itself, and runs merge equal frames
A replay from the seed and the controls gives the same scores, for one and two players, with pauses, whatever the title screen did first
A replay is refused one frame short, with a frame left over, without a start on the first frame, with fractional counts, unknown buttons or over the limit

checks.symbol: our sine and cosine agree with Math's to 1e-6

a replay is refused unless the controls play exactly one whole game
